module rtlpp_08778(clk, rst, target_angle, x_res, y_res);

  input clk, rst;
  input signed [19:0] target_angle;

  output reg signed [19:0] x_res;
  output reg signed [19:0] y_res;

  reg signed [19:0] x [9:1];
  reg signed [19:0] y [9:1];
  reg signed [19:0] z [8:1];
  reg d [8:1];

  reg signed [19:0] x4;
  reg signed [19:0] y4;
  reg signed [19:0] z4;
  reg d4;

  wire signed [19:0] look_up [8:1];

  assign look_up[1] = 20'b00000000001000110010;
  assign look_up[2] = 20'b00000000000100000101;
  assign look_up[3] = 20'b00000000000010000000;
  assign look_up[4] = 20'b00000000000001000000;
  assign look_up[5] = 20'b00000000000000100000;
  assign look_up[6] = 20'b00000000000000010000;
  assign look_up[7] = 20'b00000000000000001000;
  assign look_up[8] = 20'b00000000000000000100;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst)
  begin
    if (rst == 0) begin
      x_res <= 20'b0;
      y_res <= 20'b0;
    end else begin
      x_res <= x[9];
      y_res <= y[9];
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    x[1] = 20'b00000000010011010100; 
    y[1] = 20'b00000000000000000000; 
    z[1] = target_angle;
    d[1] = (z[1][19] == 0) ? 1 : 0;
    
    x[2] = (d[1] == 1) ? (x[1] + (y[1] >>> 1)) : (x[1] - (y[1] >>> 1));
    y[2] = (d[1] == 1) ? (y[1] + (x[1] >>> 1)) : (y[1] - (x[1] >>> 1));
    z[2] = (d[1] == 1) ? (z[1] - look_up[1]) : (z[1] + look_up[1]);
    d[2] = (z[2][19] == 0) ? 1 : 0;

    x[3] = (d[2] == 1) ? (x[2] + (y[2] >>> 2)) : (x[2] - (y[2] >>> 2));
    y[3] = (d[2] == 1) ? (y[2] + (x[2] >>> 2)) : (y[2] - (x[2] >>> 2));
    z[3] = (d[2] == 1) ? (z[2] - look_up[2]) : (z[2] + look_up[2]);
    d[3] = (z[3][19] == 0) ? 1 : 0;

    x[4] = (d[3] == 1) ? (x[3] + (y[3] >>> 3)) : (x[3] - (y[3] >>> 3));
    y[4] = (d[3] == 1) ? (y[3] + (x[3] >>> 3)) : (y[3] - (x[3] >>> 3));
    z[4] = (d[3] == 1) ? (z[3] - look_up[3]) : (z[3] + look_up[3]);
    d[4] = (z[4][19] == 0) ? 1 : 0;

    x4 = (d[4] == 1) ? (x[4] + (y[4] >>> 3)) : (x[4] - (y[4] >>> 3));
    y4 = (d[4] == 1) ? (y[4] + (x[4] >>> 3)) : (y[4] - (x[4] >>> 3));
    z4 = (d[4] == 1) ? (z[4] - look_up[3]) : (z[4] + look_up[3]);
    d4 = (z4[19] == 0) ? 1 : 0;

    x[5] = (d4 == 1) ? (x4 + (y4 >>> 4)) : (x4 - (y4 >>> 4));
    y[5] = (d4 == 1) ? (y4 + (x4 >>> 4)) : (y4 - (x4 >>> 4));
    z[5] = (d4 == 1) ? (z4 - look_up[4]) : (z4 + look_up[4]);
    d[5] = (z[5][19] == 0) ? 1 : 0;

    x[6] = (d[5] == 1) ? (x[5] + (y[5] >>> 5)) : (x[5] - (y[5] >>> 5));
    y[6] = (d[5] == 1) ? (y[5] + (x[5] >>> 5)) : (y[5] - (x[5] >>> 5));
    z[6] = (d[5] == 1) ? (z[5] - look_up[5]) : (z[5] + look_up[5]);
    d[6] = (z[6][19] == 0) ? 1 : 0;

    x[7] = (d[6] == 1) ? (x[6] + (y[6] >>> 6)) : (x[6] - (y[6] >>> 6));
    y[7] = (d[6] == 1) ? (y[6] + (x[6] >>> 6)) : (y[6] - (x[6] >>> 6));
    z[7] = (d[6] == 1) ? (z[6] - look_up[6]) : (z[6] + look_up[6]);
    d[7] = (z[7][19] == 0) ? 1 : 0;

    x[8] = (d[7] == 1) ? (x[7] + (y[7] >>> 7)) : (x[7] - (y[7] >>> 7));
    y[8] = (d[7] == 1) ? (y[7] + (x[7] >>> 7)) : (y[7] - (x[7] >>> 7));
    z[8] = (d[7] == 1) ? (z[7] - look_up[7]) : (z[7] + look_up[7]);
    d[8] = (z[8][19] == 0) ? 1 : 0;

    x[9] = (d[8] == 1) ? (x[8] + (y[8] >>> 8)) : (x[8] - (y[8] >>> 8));
    y[9] = (d[8] == 1) ? (y[8] + (x[8] >>> 8)) : (y[8] - (x[8] >>> 8));
  end

endmodule
